title: AI Is Entering the Editable Motion Pipeline: Spec, AE, and Handoff
summary: MotionSpec defines the rules, MotionPilot builds editable AE motion, and MotionSheet hands it off and audits it against the same shared spec.

zh.title: 动效设计最危险的一刻：AI 开始接管从规范到交付的整条链路
zh.short_title: AI 开始接管整条动效链路
zh.summary: MotionSpec 定规范、MotionPilot 在 AE 生成、MotionSheet 交付与走查；一份 motion-tokens.json 开始贯穿可编辑的动效生产链。

title: Claude Account Suspended? A VPS Might Be the Answer
summary: Instead of jumping between devices, networks, and proxy chains, I keep Claude on one capable VPS: SSH-only when I can, or a lightweight Ubuntu desktop over Tailscale/RDP when I need a GUI. The goal isn't to dodge detection — just to stop my Claude usage from drifting all over the place.

zh.title: Claude 封号？VPS 或许才是终极答案
zh.short_title: Claude 封号？VPS 或许是答案
zh.summary: 与其反复折腾网络、设备和代理，我干脆把 Claude 的活都挪到一台配置够用的 VPS 上：能 SSH 就 SSH，要图形界面就装个轻量 Ubuntu 桌面，再用 Tailscale 从几台设备连进去。这么做主要是想让自己用 Claude 的方式别再东一下西一下，不是冲着躲检测去的。

title: Stop Trusting a Single Temperature Source: Verified JSON for an AMD Synology NAS
summary: On an AMD Synology, no single tool reliably reports CPU, board, and disk temperatures. I pick the best source per value, merge them into one small JSON endpoint, and cross-check every reading against an independent source.

zh.title: 别再相信单一温度来源：我给 AMD 群晖做了一份可验证的温度 JSON
zh.short_title: AMD 群晖温度 JSON：别信单一来源
zh.summary: AMD 群晖上没有一个工具能稳定读全 CPU、主板和每块硬盘温度。我把每个值从最靠谱的来源取出来，合并成一份 JSON，再用独立来源逐项交叉验证，最后喂给桌面小屏。

title: I Built a Zero-Build Blog: Just Markdown and git push
summary: No Hugo, no Jekyll, no node_modules, no CI. The repo is the website — write a Markdown file, push, and a ~400-line vanilla-JS engine renders it. Here's how it works and the one rate-limit pit I fell into.

zh.title: 我做了个零构建博客：写 Markdown、git push 就发布
zh.summary: 没有 Hugo、没有 Jekyll、没有 node_modules、没有 CI。仓库本身就是网站——写一个 Markdown 文件、push，一个约 400 行的原生 JS 引擎就把它渲染出来。这篇讲它怎么跑，以及我踩的那个限流坑。

title: AI ChatHub: a Multi-AI Side-Panel Extension That Hedges API vs. Tab-Orchestration
summary: A WXT + React 19 MV3 side-panel extension that broadcasts one prompt to several AI panes. The interesting decision was shipping two engines at once — a clean OpenAI-compatible streaming mode and a "webtab" mode that drives your already-logged-in tabs — because each alone isn't enough.

zh.title: AI ChatHub：一个多 AI 并排的浏览器侧边栏扩展——API 聚合与「标签页编排」两条腿走路
zh.short_title: AI ChatHub：API 与标签页双引擎
zh.summary: 用 WXT + React 19 写的 MV3 侧边栏扩展，一个输入框把同一问题同时发给多个 AI 窗格。最有意思的决定是同时塞了两套引擎——干净的 OpenAI 兼容流式模式，和一套驱动你"已登录标签页"的 webtab 模式——因为每套单独都不够。

title: Build Your Own Multi-Model AI Gateway in a Day: Turn Paid Subscriptions into a Family-Wide Hub
short_title: Multi-Model AI Gateway in a Day
summary: From ChatALL pitfalls to rolling my own — a subscription bridge + Open WebUI + NAS, a family-shared, side-by-side multi-model AI hub built in a day.

zh.title: 一天搭建自己的多模型 AI 网关：把付费订阅变成全家共享入口
zh.short_title: 一天搭建多模型 AI 网关
zh.summary: 从 ChatALL 踩坑到自建——用订阅桥 + Open WebUI + NAS，一天搭出全家共享、多模型并排的 AI 入口。

title: The First Feature in My Trading Dashboard Was Not a Chart. It Was a Read-Only Boundary.
summary: A local-first, self-hosted trading analytics dashboard that reads positions, delayed market data, macro context, and a personal rule base. It computes deterministic context and LLM prompts, but never places orders or emits trade signals.

zh.title: 我做交易面板时最先写的不是图表，而是“只读边界”
zh.short_title: 交易面板第一步：只读边界
zh.summary: 一个自托管交易分析面板，聚合只读券商持仓、延迟行情、宏观数据和个人法则库。本地计算数学期望并拼装 LLM 提示词，但架构上不下单、不发信号、不承诺收益。

title: Silence Is an Eternal Theme
summary: A farewell under a 38°C blaze — looking back to where it all felt certain, meetings and partings, and a steadfast creed that we will surely meet again.

zh.title: 静默是永恒的主题
zh.summary: 38℃烈日下的告别——回望认定的那一瞬，聚散离合，以及"必然会再次相遇"的坚定信条。

title: Gentle Gale
summary: A quiet afternoon at the Fourteen-Inch Resort — post-rock in my ears, draped in a gentle gale, wanting only to walk this road to its end.

zh.title: 和煦暴风
zh.summary: 十四寸度假村的宁静午后——耳边后摇，覆着和煦暴风，只想走完这段路。
